description:
Toronto Metropolitan University – formerly known as Ryerson University is a public research university located in Ontario, Canada. Its urban campus surrounds Yonge-Dundas Square, located at one of the busiest intersections in downtown Toronto. Most of its buildings are located northeast of Yonge-Dundas Square in Toronto's Garden District.

Toronto Metropolitan University has pioneered a unique experiential program called zone learning—a great complement to your courses with the opportunity to earn an additional credential on your transcript. You'll work with like-minded students from diverse disciplines and community groups.

The university offers 62 bachelor’s degree, 55 PhD and master’s programs to over 48,000 students from all around the world. Toronto Metropolitan University MBA ranked among the top business programs in Canada based on value for money (Canadian Business, 2016).

Here are some of the popular undergraduate and graduate programs TMU offers.

Toronto Metropolitan University has 4 dormitories of its own. You have many options from single rooms to 4-person rooms. Your advisor will contact you about this during your application.
